checks.name: F_n = (2n/3) z^(3/2) - (n(n+1)/4) z^2 + ...
checks.threshold: must equal 2n/3 and -n(n+1)/4 identically in n

checks.name: leading term is NON-ANALYTIC (half-integer power), no z^1 term
checks.measured: F_n(z) ~ z^(3/2); the coefficient of z^1 is 0 for every n
checks.threshold: F'(0) = mu(0) = 0  =>  no quadratic kinetic term at the origin

checks.name: after fixing a0, exactly ONE free number distinguishes the members
checks.threshold: one-parameter family => n <-> a single ratio; a bound on it is the only way in

checks.name: that invariant is continuous and strictly monotone in n
checks.threshold: => any two-sided bound carves an INTERVAL of n, it can never select one member

checks.name: kinetic matrix degenerates at z = 0: no propagator, no asymptotic states
checks.measured: F'(z) -> 0 and z F''(z) -> 0 as z -> 0
checks.threshold: both invariants of G^{mu nu} vanish => infinitely strong coupling at the vacuum

checks.name: so the AADNR premise (a gapped, weakly coupled, Lorentz-invariant vacuum with an analytic s-expansion) is absent, for every n
checks.measured: the obstruction is n-independent: F'(0)=0 holds for all n>0
checks.threshold: positivity bounds are not violated here -- they are inapplicable

checks.name: F'' > 0 for every member and every Y (so P'' < 0: the forbidden sign)
checks.measured: F''(z) = mu'(Y)/(2Y) = n*(Y + 1)**(-n - 1)/(2*Y); positive on a 6x6 grid in (n, Y): True
checks.threshold: AADNR/forward positivity wants P'' > 0 <=> F'' <= 0; violated by ALL n, none selected

checks.name: the violation is forced by MOND itself, not by the choice of family
checks.measured: F''(z) = mu'(Y)/(2Y) > 0 <=> mu increasing; any interpolation 0 -> 1 is increasing

checks.name: c_par^2 = 1 + dln(mu)/dln(Y) -> 2 in the deep-MOND limit for EVERY n
checks.threshold: the deep-MOND speed is sqrt(2) c exactly, with no n-dependence to exploit

checks.name: superluminal at every finite Y, for every n (no member is rescued)
checks.threshold: c_par^2 > 1 everywhere => the causality test does not discriminate between members; large n only makes the excess die faster in the Newtonian tail (~ n Y^-n)

checks.name: the deep value is fixed by Milgrom scale invariance alone, not by the kernel
checks.measured: for mu ~ Y^p, c_par^2 -> p + 1; MOND forces p = 1 (g = sqrt(g_N a0)) => c^2 = 2
checks.threshold: any theory with the deep-MOND limit has scalar cone exactly sqrt(2) wider than light

checks.name: every standard MOND kernel is superluminal too
checks.measured: all four exceed 1 on the grid: True
checks.threshold: the pathology is a property of MOND, not of this family or of its exponent

checks.name: (a) F' = mu > 0 and (b) 2 z F'' + F' > 0 hold for the whole family
checks.measured: (a) all true: True;  (b) all true: True
checks.threshold: the equations stay hyperbolic; only condition (c) F'' <= 0 fails -- again for all n

checks.name: the advance is enormous compared with any wavelength inside the EFT's validity
checks.measured: ~4.78e+04 yr over 50 kpc, versus resolution ~ wavelength/c for lambda << 50 kpc
checks.threshold: so the 'unresolvable superluminality' escape of arXiv:2207.03491 is NOT available; but the advance is n-independent, so this too fails to select n
